title: SBRING02 shared ring, cancellation, retirement, and memfd transport probe

sources.notes: Make target graph, not a C++ symbol surface: separates transport-probe, host-only shared-ring-tests, and real b70-ring-integration binaries; modeled only as subsystem/dependency boundaries.

Exact fixed control-plane packets are abstracted by authentication acceptance/rejection and lifecycle actions; packet sizes, magic, reserved bytes, fault acknowledgements, and allocation counters are documented rather than byte-modeled.

Real B70 process/ring harness for authenticated startup negatives, zero-remote bypass, numerical cases, eight-slot backpressure and wrap reuse, timing, and clean shutdown accounting; no harness result is claimed here.

Models trusted bootstrap gating, canonical request validation, single-flight issue/take outcome, explicit closure of valid error claims, terminal publication, and control shutdown. SHA-256 bytes, device math, polling duration, and detailed exit codes are abstract.

Independent SBP2MEMF host lifecycle is modeled as one-lane publish/copy/reset/shutdown, explicitly not as SBRING02. CUDA byte generation/copies, timing statistics, process cleanup, and device identity checks are documented/abstract.
Models probe sequence, phase, extent validity, completion and shutdown. Exact cache-line layout, one-MiB disjoint arenas and transfer-size constants are documented but not represented as byte arrays.

Models exact-sequence claim, invalid extent failure, successful dependent round trip, and clean shutdown. SCM_RIGHTS parsing, SYCL allocation/profiling, device selection, copy exceptions, and multi-session loop remain implementation-level behavior described in the chapter.

Authoritative SBRING02 ABI. Model preserves lane states, closure, terminal identity, generations, output visibility and retirement; fixed offsets, extents, dtypes, nonce/fingerprint bytes and platform static assertions are chapter-level functional constraints.

Primary behavioral correspondence. Each atomic publication/CAS boundary is one model action; exact SHA-256 computation and byte-level descriptor validation are collapsed into explicit validity booleans while output exposure and error branches remain distinct.

Public SPSC API and typed payload ownership. Model represents lifecycle/status distinctions and matching ticket identity but abstracts raw pointers, spans, move-only descriptor ownership and mapping visitor.
CPU/fork protocol comparison surface covering the model's critical success, error, quarantine, stale, reuse and retirement branches. It is explicitly not a CUDA/B70 acceptance harness.

CPU-only correspondence harness over the actual SharedRing host/provider APIs and shared_ring.cpp. It asserts real publication states, RingStatus results, output exposure, quarantine, raw stale completion rejection, destructive retirement and fresh-generation admission; it does not instantiate or mock B70 compute. Exact command: g++ -std=c++20 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -pthread -Isrc/phase2 specs/reyu/ring_correspondence.cpp src/phase2/shared_ring.cpp -o /tmp/ring_correspondence. Matching runs: successAndSafeReuseTest, preclaimCancellationTombstoneTest, postclaimDeadlineQuarantineTest (cancellation variant), staleCompletionNeverExposesOutputTest, retirementRequiresFreshGenerationTest.

Historical declarative protocol-v1 schema has no code symbols. It is included only to make the incompatibility with executable SBRING02 explicit: logical head/tail statuses, compact IDs and failed-mask recovery are not modeled as the Phase-2 wire ABI.
Downstream single-flight compute boundary invoked by the ring bridge. Status-to-wire mapping is represented; kernel/device and provider-internal mechanics belong to the provider model.

assumptions: The model's representative lane stands for the deterministic selected slot (request_seq-1)%8; the chapter and source retain the production eight-slot capacity and full-ring behavior.

Boolean descriptorExact, payloadValid, completionIdentityExact, outputFinite and probeExtentValid summarize the exact source validators; no cryptographic collision resistance or byte-layout proof is claimed.
Each Reyu action corresponds to one source ownership/publication boundary. Linux release/acquire ordering, interprocess cache coherence and eventfd syscall behavior remain implementation assumptions.
Eventfd notifications are omitted from SBRING02 model state because SharedRing treats them as coalescible hints; slot state remains authoritative.
Replacement after retirement represents construction of a fresh SharedRing mapping with fresh identity, not resurrection of a dead mapping.
SBP2MEMF probe state is intentionally independent of SBRING02 service state; a probe success provides copy-path evidence only, not expert-service correctness.
Protocol-v1 provider_protocol.yaml is historical logical design input, not the executable serialization accepted by SharedRing.

Numerical B70 computation, bank contents, placement derivation, CUDA/SYCL device selection, timing and allocation internals are external to this model and must be checked by their implementation harnesses.

implementation_checks.description: Compile with g++ -std=c++20 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -pthread -Isrc/phase2 specs/reyu/ring_correspondence.cpp src/phase2/shared_ring.cpp -o /tmp/ring_correspondence, then run /tmp/ring_correspondence to compare actual SharedRing success, cancellation/quarantine, stale completion, retirement and replacement observations with the named Reyu runs.

CPU-run the real memfd ring success path and compare the observed FREE→HOST_WRITING→REQUEST_READY→PROVIDER_RUNNING→RESPONSE_READY→HOST_READING→FREE sequence and payload visibility with successAndSafeReuseTest.
CPU-differentially compare pre-claim cancellation tombstones and post-claim timeout quarantine; verify ConstCompletionPayload output remains null for both closed lanes.
Exercise real mask, canonical ID, row-map, route-position and raw-offset failures and compare publication/claim state plus non-exposure with the malformed model scenarios.
CPU/fork-compare provider death behavior: the claimed old slot remains running until destructive generation retirement, old reclamation fails, and only a newly created generation serves again.
Confirm an attached process acquires the shared dead flag and that later attach and host_begin reject the retired generation.
Compile a CPU-only layout inspector or inspect the existing static assertions for exact struct sizes, offsets, payload stride 1589248 and mapping size 12726272; compare with chapter inventory.
Drive real completions with matching, stale, failed and quarantined identities and compare RingStatus plus whether output_fp32 is exposed against model Observation values.
Source-inspect the bridge's stricter canonical row/route and finite-weight checks against SharedRing payload validation; flag future divergence before any hardware run.
Source-compare logical v1 request/completion fields with SBRING02 descriptors and SBP2MEMF publications so inventories never treat these three incompatible contracts as aliases.
